title: Stationary filtered subquotient comparison at two explicit outer bounds
statement: Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], K an integer-indexed cochain complex, and L a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration]. Let I_n be the cohomology image filtration defined in [lem-sp-filtered-cohomology-image-finite]. For integers p,n,r with r≥1 suppose L^(p+r)K^(n+1)=0 and L^(p-r+1)K^(n-1)=K^(n-1), using [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. For any proof hBZ that B_r^{p,n}≤Z_r^{p,n}, the cokernel of this inclusion is isomorphic to gr^p I_n. No degreewise or globally finite filtration assumption is made.

proof.text: In the explicit formulas for complexCycles and complexBoundaries, rewrite the upper step to bottom and the lower step to top. The image of top under the incoming differential is its imageSubobject. This gives equalities with the two normalized subobjects Zbar and Bbar.

Transfer the supplied containment hBZ along the two subobject equalities. Equality of subobjects gives an isomorphism of the cokernels of their inclusions, by substituting the equal objects and proof irrelevance. Apply normalizedStationaryQuotient_presentation to identify this quotient with the cycle presentation.

Apply cohomologyImage_graded_presentation and compose its inverse with the preceding two isomorphisms. This identifies the original stationary quotient with gradedPiece p of cohomologyImage n, without changing any hypotheses.

lean.statement:
theorem stableSubquotient_at_bounds
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    {K : CochainComplex C ℤ} (L : DecreasingFiltration K)
    (p n r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hupper : L.complexStep (p + r) (n + 1) = ⊥)
    (hlower : L.complexStep (p - r + 1) (n - 1) = ⊤)
    (hBZ : L.complexBoundaries p n r ≤ L.complexCycles p n r) :
    Nonempty (cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _ hBZ) ≅
      (L.cohomologyImage n).gradedPiece p)
